issue.title: Add Claim and Assignment Indicators to Chapter List Rows
issue.body: The chapter list has no way to show whether a chapter is unassigned, claimed by the current user, or taken by another translator. This ticket adds the `li:user` icon slot to chapter rows and implements the three ownership states. A fourth state — conflict — shares this slot and is implemented separately in #260. The sync status icon is a distinct surface and is not part of this ticket. ## Functional Requirements ### Chapter List Row — Ownership Indicator - Add a `li:user` icon slot to each chapter row in the chapter list, to the right of the sync indicator (`li:cloud-upload`); the slot is visible on all rows regardless of state. - When a chapter is unassigned (no recordings from any translator), show no icon in the slot. - When a chapter is claimed or PM-assigned to the current user (eg. Mark 9), display `li:user` filled in the primary color (`#0b50d0`). - When a chapter is claimed or PM-assigned to another translator (eg. Mark 10, display `li:user` filled in neutral/muted. Note: The conflict state (`li:users` with a `li:triangle-alert` badge) occupies the same slot and is implemented in #260. This ticket covers the three non-conflict ownership states only.

**Test Results – #267: PR Tested #328**

- When the Project Manager assigns a chapter to the current translator, the translator can view the chapter in the My Work tab. The assigned chapter displays the li:user icon filled with the primary color (#0b50d0).
- When a chapter is reassigned to another translator, it is removed from the current user's My Work tab. When the chapter is opened from the My Projects page, the li:user icon is displayed in a muted color, indicating that the chapter is assigned to another translator.
- When a chapter is unassigned, no li:user icon is displayed in the chapter list.
- The li:user icon does not overflow or overlap with other UI elements.
- Scrolling behavior, icon color, and overall UI are working as expected.
